name: search_pattern_map
description: Plots the search pattern onto a map. Call this function whenever appropriate.

location.description: Commence search point of the search.

name: survivor_status_calculation
description: Calculates the estimated survival time of a survivor based on environmental conditions. Call this function whenever appropriate.

survivor_condition.description: Initial condition of the survivor (e.g., healthy, injured).

additional_factors.description: Additional factors that may impact the survival time, such as dangerous animals.

name: weather_forecast
description: Generates a weather forecast for search and rescue operations. Call this function whenever appropriate.

forecast_duration.description: Duration of the forecast in hours.

name: survivor_location_calculation
description: Calculates the location of a survivor based on last known position and drift. Call this function whenever appropriate.

last_known_position.description: Last known position of the survivor (e.g., latitude, longitude).

drift_speed.description: Speed of the drift in knots.

drift_direction.description: Direction of the drift (e.g., N, S, E, W).

name: sunset
description: Estimates the local time the sun sets. Call this function whenever appropriate.

position.description: Estimated position of the survivor (e.g., latitude, longitude).

name: sunrise
description: Estimates the local time the sun rises. Call this function whenever appropriate.

position.description: Estimated position of the survivor (e.g., latitude, longitude).
